title: Portfolio Website
shortDescription: An interactive portfolio website built with Next.js, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS, featuring a sky-to-ground landscape concept.
fullDetails: Built a modern web interface with glassmorphism effects, interactive timeline animations, and an automated contact form integration using Web3Forms. Designed responsively with dark mode support.
features: Interactive Wavy Timeline & Organization Grid Modal
Dynamic Sky Background & Smooth Scroll Animations
Integrated Email Contact Form

title: Rat in Maze
shortDescription: A simple C++ program that solves the maze problem using a backtracking algorithm.
fullDetails: A simple C++ program that solves the maze problem using a backtracking algorithm, built as the final project for a fundamentals of programming course.
features: Maze input using 0 (representing a wall) and 1 (representing a path)
Outputs the path taken by the rat from the starting point to the endpoint

title: Database Management System for a Restaurant
shortDescription: A database management system for a restaurant that enables managing menu, order, and customer data.
fullDetails: A database management system for a restaurant that enables managing menu, order, and customer data, built using Microsoft Access.
features: Users can view menu, order, and customer data
Admins can add, delete, and edit menu, order, and customer data
Admins can view key information such as total sales, best-selling menu items, and loyal customers

title: Javanese-English-Indonesian Dictionary
shortDescription: A web-based dictionary for translating single words from Javanese to English and Indonesian, and vice versa.
fullDetails: A web-based dictionary for translating single words from Javanese to English and Indonesian, and vice versa, built using CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and AJAX.
features: Users can translate words from Javanese to English and Indonesian, and vice versa
Admins can add, delete, and edit words in the dictionary

title: Flappy Bird Game
fullDetails: A simple Flappy Bird game developed using Java to fulfill the final assignment for an object-oriented programming course.
features: Users can play the Flappy Bird game
Users can view the highest score achieved

title: UNO Multiplayer Game
shortDescription: A UNO game that can be played by multiple players online.
fullDetails: A UNO game that can be played by multiple players online, built using Python and socket programming to fulfill the final assignment for a computer networks course.
features: Users can play UNO with multiple players, but must be on the same internet connection
Users can view the game status and scores

title: Miuwsweeper
shortDescription: Miuwsweeper, a cat-themed version of the Minesweeper game.
fullDetails: Miuwsweeper, a cat-themed version of the Minesweeper game, built using Python, Tkinter, and BFS and DFS algorithms to fulfill the final assignment for a Design and Analysis of Algorithms course.
features: Users can play the Miuwsweeper game
Users can set the game's difficulty level
Users can restart the game

title: DSA and RSA Algorithm Implementation
shortDescription: Implementation of DSA and RSA algorithms for encrypting and decrypting messages between devices.
fullDetails: Implementation of DSA and RSA algorithms for encrypting and decrypting messages between devices, built using Python and the Cryptography library to fulfill the final assignment for a data security course.
features: Users can send messages to different devices, with messages automatically encrypted
Users can view the keys used for encrypting and decrypting messages
Users can view received messages, which are automatically decrypted

title: Customer Arrival Simulation at a Bank
shortDescription: A simulation of customer arrivals at a bank using JaamSim.
fullDetails: A simulation of customer arrivals at a bank using JaamSim, applying discrete and continuous distribution approaches, to fulfill the final assignment for a modeling and simulation course.
features: Users can view the customer arrival simulation
Users can view customer quantity statistics
Users can view customer waiting times

title: Building an Expert System for Sentiment Analysis on Airline Services
shortDescription: Building an expert system for sentiment analysis on airline services using BERT.
fullDetails: Building an expert system for sentiment analysis on airline services using BERT to fulfill the final assignment for a Knowledge-Based Systems Engineering course.
features: Users can input new airline service feedback data and get sentiment analysis results from that data
Users can view sentiment analysis statistics from existing airline service feedback data

title: Building a Website for Preventive Maintenance of Machines at PLN
shortDescription: Building a website for preventive maintenance of machines at PLN using Laravel.
fullDetails: Building a website for preventive maintenance of machines at PLN using Laravel to fulfill an internship (Praktik Kerja Lapangan) assignment.
features: Users can input maintenance history data or record new maintenance data and get analysis results from that data
Users can view analysis statistics from existing maintenance history data and recommendations for the next maintenance date

title: Building a Financial Literacy Gamification Website for the Financial Services Authority (OJK)
shortDescription: Building a financial literacy gamification website for the Financial Services Authority (OJK) using Laravel.
fullDetails: Building a financial literacy gamification website for the Financial Services Authority (OJK) using Laravel to fulfill a Capstone course assignment.
features: Users can play the game without needing to log in
Users can view statistics from games already played
Users can edit their profile and customize their avatar
Users can earn rewards in the form of badges and points from games already played
